cause_quote: The new host gate required `params.pluginOrigin === "bundled" && BUNDLED_CHANNELS_WITH_PROVIDER_READ_GATES.has(params.ctx.channel)` to defer delegated cross-conversation reads to Discord or Slack, so installed copies fell through to the exact-current-conversation check.
user_saw: An agent using an installed official Discord or Slack plugin was denied access to another conversation that its configured account was allowed to read.
summary: The fix restores provider-permitted context reads for verified official Discord and Slack installations and checks that caller and plugin authority remain valid through provider requests and result delivery.
reasoning: The parent of #99905 already had installable Discord and Slack packages, and its dispatcher passed supported read actions to the selected adapter, where existing handlers enforced destination policy and could read a permitted target. #99905 inserted the bundled-only check before adapter dispatch, and the later read-gate refactor preserved that restriction.
